Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

typstR 0.1.0

First release preparation; CRAN submission and acceptance are not yet recorded. Planning milestones v1.0–v1.5 are internal identifiers, not package versions.

Audit corrections

  • Fix singleton keyword/JEL rendering, pass through Quarto page, font, numbering, and TOC controls, and apply title-font with explicit branding precedence.
  • Consolidate publication variants and implement lettered academic appendices with a bundled filter while preserving import paths and public R returns.
  • Validate constructor metadata consistently, distinguish cross-references from citations, and reject misplaced anonymization settings.
  • Preserve literal scaffold titles, implement scaffold opening, and resolve actual Quarto output paths before opening rendered PDFs.
  • Add PDF content/property assertions and required Linux minimum/current and Windows render lanes. Early Quarto 1.4 uses standalone Typst on PATH.

Validation and encoding corrections

  • Fail closed on publication overrides in both local project config filenames, including format-specific metadata; allow empty/editor-only local files.
  • Require canonical YAML booleans consistently with Quarto and diagnose environment-file profiles before rendering.
  • Encode Typst string metadata independently of content markup, preserving quotes, backslashes, Unicode and line breaks in publication fields and paths.
  • Ignore HTML comments and indented code during citation preflight, and detect suppressed-author citations such as [-@key].
  • Require quarto R 1.5.0 for quarto_available() and testthat 3.1.7 for namespace mocking; the Quarto CLI minimum remains 1.4.11. Extend the nine required render scenarios with literal metadata and anonymity regressions.

Test suite simplification

  • Keep ordinary tests independent of Quarto and Poppler; consolidate scaffold, validation, and render-path regressions using package loading and scoped mocks.
  • Reduce required PDF assurance from fifteen to nine scenarios per toolchain, retaining all three variants and the Linux minimum/current and Windows lanes.
  • Move benchmarks and baseline validation to the explicit developer command; rely on R CMD check for documentation structure instead of custom Rd tests.

First release reliability (planning milestone v1.5)

  • Resolve manuscript and project context before preflight so documented file paths, directory input, spaces and outside-project rendering work reliably.
  • Add shared validate_manuscript() checks for static YAML, supported formats, publication metadata and local resources, with stable ordered diagnostics.
  • Require dedicated Quarto-enabled PDF assurance and preserve render artifacts; keep ordinary package checks usable without Quarto.
  • Separate performance measurement from ordinary test runs and retain historical benchmark contracts without making unmeasured speed claims.

Branding and release hardening (planning milestones v1.3–v1.4)

  • Add a documentation logo, favicon, branded styling, advanced examples and a comparison of the three publication variants.
  • Harden checks for environments without Quarto, stabilize Windows diagnostics, minimize runtime dependencies and prepare submission metadata.

Documentation (planning milestone v1.2)

  • Polished the documentation surface around one onboarding-first story spanning the README, pkgdown home page, and articles.
  • Added a stricter exported-reference audit so incomplete help pages are caught before regenerated Rd files ship.
  • Started the pkgdown/news/build-ignore foundation needed for the documentation and website polish milestone.

Reliability and onboarding (planning milestone v1.1)

  • Added structured diagnostics with stable codes, ordering, and payload fields for validation and render failures.
  • Introduced pre-render environment validation with explicit Quarto, Typst, version-floor, and extension checks.
  • Locked first-run scaffold reliability across working paper, article, and policy brief formats, then added measured performance regression coverage.
  • Closed the milestone with supported-environment evidence and audit-complete validation artifacts.

Foundation (planning milestone v1.0)

  • Shipped the initial typstR package with working paper, article, and policy brief scaffolds plus Typst-backed Quarto output formats.
  • Added manuscript metadata helpers, publication helpers, and YAML-driven template integration for research documents.
  • Hardened the package with tests, starter documentation, and CRAN-ready packaging conventions.
